OD-B13-S01-T01.line: There, friends. My story is told, and the telling has emptied me.

OD-B13-S01-T02.line: Bring out one more chest, and let every lord of Phaeacia add a tripod and a cauldron to it. Then set the feast, for our guest sails at sundown and he must leave us glad.

OD-B13-S01-T03.line: Farewell, generous hearts. May the gods repay this house with every good thing.
OD-B13-S01-T03.direction: boards ship, lies down on the stern bed

OD-B13-S01-T04.line: Swifter than a wheeling hawk the ship ran on, and the man who had suffered twenty years of salt and war slept past all sorrow. Before the dawn-star rose, her keel touched Ithaca.
OD-B13-S01-T04.direction: steady, low, over the sleeping man

OD-B13-S01-T05.line: Easy now. Lift him gently, and the treasure after.
OD-B13-S01-T05.direction: carry sleeper and gifts ashore, push off in silence

OD-B13-S02-T01.line: What land is this now, and what people? The very air is a stranger to me.
OD-B13-S02-T01.direction: wakes alone, stares through the mist

OD-B13-S02-T02.line: Tripods, cauldrons, the woven robes, the gold. All of it here, nothing taken. Then why does this shore know nothing of me, unless those sailors dumped me on some foreign coast?
OD-B13-S02-T02.direction: counts the gifts piece by piece

OD-B13-S02-T03.line: Wretched again, and among strangers again. O Zeus, where do I carry all this wealth, and where do I carry myself?

OD-B13-S02-T04.line: Good day to you, stranger. You look like a man who has lost his road.
OD-B13-S02-T04.direction: ambles up in a young shepherd's guise

OD-B13-S03-T01.line: Hear it, Odysseus, and hold your face still. The shepherd boy names this rough land Ithaca, and your heart leaps like a fish behind your teeth, and you let nothing show.

OD-B13-S03-T02.line: And what does he answer? A lie, fresh-minted: he is a Cretan, he says, a killer fleeing blood-price, carried here on a Phoenician ship. One hour home, and already armored in fiction.

OD-B13-S03-T03.line: Cunning, insatiable trickster, even in your own land you will not lay your lies aside! Enough now: I am Athena, daughter of Zeus, and we two are alike, crooked-minded both, you the best of mortals at scheming and I of gods.
OD-B13-S03-T03.direction: disguise falls away, laughing, tall and radiant

OD-B13-S03-T04.line: Hard goddess, where were you all the salt years since Troy burned? You stood at my shoulder then, and after, I never once saw you on my deck while I suffered. Now you come smiling and tell me this is Ithaca, so swear it is not one more mockery.
OD-B13-S03-T04.direction: grief and challenge, equal to equal

OD-B13-S03-T05.line: So that is the shape of it. Poseidon's wrath made open rescue too costly, and you wore silence the way I wear rags. You hid me even from my own eyes to keep me breathing.
OD-B13-S03-T05.direction: turning her reasons over, half forgiving

OD-B13-S04-T01.line: In with them. Your bronze and gold will keep better here than on any beach.
OD-B13-S04-T01.direction: hefts treasure into the nymphs' cave

OD-B13-S04-T02.line: There. No thief alive will shift that stone. Now sit with me under the olive, and let us plot.
OD-B13-S04-T02.direction: seals the cave mouth, sits beneath the olive

OD-B13-S04-T03.line: Count them with me: a hundred lordly young men and more, three years camped in your hall, eating your herds and courting your wife. Two of us against all of those, and I like our odds.

OD-B13-S04-T04.line: Go first to your swineherd Eumaeus, keeper of your pigs and lover of your house, and stay by his fire and question everything. I go to Sparta, to fetch your son home.

OD-B13-S05-T01.line: Hold still now. This will not be kind.
OD-B13-S05-T01.direction: touches him with the wand, skin withers, hair falls

OD-B13-S05-T02.line: Dimmed eyes, wracked limbs, rags fit for burning on an old man's back. No one who ever loved you will look at you twice. Take this staff and this patched beggar's sack, for this is who you are now.

OD-B13-S05-T03.line: So the king goes among his own people as nothing at all: a ruined old man on a mountain path, sent to weigh the hearts of servants, and no eye in Ithaca to know him.

OD-B13-S05-T04.line: To Sparta, for the boy. Walk on, old beggar, and keep to the high path.
OD-B13-S05-T04.direction: departs skyward, he turns toward the farm

OD-B14-S01-T01.line: Smoke, and the smell of pigs. Someone keeps this hill better than the palace keeps itself.

OD-B14-S01-T02.line: Out of the yard four dogs came at him like wolves, and the man dropped his staff and sat down in the dirt, old soldier's craft, letting their fury break over a harmless thing.

OD-B14-S01-T03.line: Back! Off him, you brutes, off! Old man, another moment and you'd have been torn, and the shame of it mine forever.
OD-B14-S01-T03.direction: hurls stones, scatters dogs, lifts the stranger

OD-B14-S01-T04.line: Sit, grandfather, here, my own seat by the fire. Two young pigs I'll dress for us; eat first, and tell your griefs after.
OD-B14-S01-T04.direction: spreads a shaggy goatskin, sets to butchering

OD-B14-S02-T01.line: Forgive the poor meat, old man; young pork is all the suitors leave us. The fattened boars go down the mountain to men who eat a lost king's herds and fear no god watching.

OD-B14-S02-T02.line: My master, and I will say his name, Odysseus, was kind to me past any telling, and the sea has him now, dead in some far water. Every drifter who wants supper sings me a tale that he lives. I have stopped believing songs.

OD-B14-S02-T03.line: Then hear an oath, not a song. By Zeus of guests, by this table and this fire: Odysseus comes home before this year is out. When he stands in his own hall, give me a cloak and tunic then, and not one hour before.

OD-B14-S02-T04.line: Keep your oath, friend, for I'll pay no cloak on it, and Odysseus will not come. Drink your wine and speak of other things; my heart aches enough whenever his name is said.
OD-B14-S02-T04.direction: gentle refusal, refills the cup anyway

OD-B14-S03-T01.line: But you now, who are you, and from where among men? What ship brought you, and what grief? For no man walks to Ithaca.

OD-B14-S03-T02.line: Crete, then Troy, then Egypt in chains, go on, leave nothing out. And this Thesprotian king, say again what he swore to you about Odysseus and the treasure coming home.

OD-B14-S03-T03.line: Mark how he builds it: true harbors, true wars, true hunger, and a false name at the keel. The lie is a net, cast gently, to sound the depth of the swineherd's heart.

OD-B14-S03-T04.line: Poor man, your wanderings wring my heart, and every word of hardship I believe. But the word about Odysseus, no. Why do you good men think a lie will comfort me?

OD-B14-S04-T01.line: Night came down foul, moonless, black rain on a wet west wind, and the herdsmen came in from the pens to the fire, and the cold began its work on the old man's shoulders.

OD-B14-S04-T02.line: Hear a boast from an old soldier, since wine loosens me. One freezing ambush-night at Troy I lay without a cloak, and Odysseus spun a trick on the spot that got one onto my shoulders. Ah, to be that young man tonight, someone in this hut might do the same.
OD-B14-S04-T02.direction: shivering, sly, palms to the fire

OD-B14-S04-T03.line: Well hinted, old man, and no fault in the hint. Here, my spare cloak, sleep warm.
OD-B14-S04-T03.direction: throws a heavy cloak over him

OD-B14-S04-T04.line: The herd won't guard itself in weather like this. Sleep, all of you.
OD-B14-S04-T04.direction: takes spear and fleece, beds down near the pigs

OD-B15-S01-T01.line: Telemachus, wake. It is wrong to wander while your house is eaten hollow. Go home now, before your mother's own kin bend her to marry Eurymachus and your inheritance walks out the door with her.
OD-B15-S01-T01.direction: stands over his bed in the dark

OD-B15-S01-T02.line: And hear this too: the boldest of the suitors lie in ambush in the strait between Ithaca and rocky Same, hungry for your blood before you ever reach home. Keep clear of that channel, sail wide, and sail by night.
OD-B15-S01-T02.direction: urgent, tracing the route in the air

OD-B15-S01-T03.line: When you touch Ithaca, send ship and crew round to the town without you. Go first, on foot, to the swineherd Eumaeus, who keeps faith with your house; sleep there, and send him to tell your mother you are safely home.

OD-B15-S01-T04.line: Pisistratus, up. Yoke the horses, we go home at first light.

OD-B15-S02-T01.line: Menelaus, dear to Zeus, your gifts honor me and I take them gladly. But do not hold me for more feasting; my heart is already on Ithaca, and I fear what rots there while I linger.

OD-B15-S02-T02.line: Take this robe, child, woven by my own hands, for the bride you will one day wed; let your mother keep it till then. And read that eagle with the white goose in its claws as I do: so Odysseus, home from long wandering, will stoop upon the suitors, or he is home already, seeding their ruin.
OD-B15-S02-T02.direction: lays the robe in his arms, eyes on the sky

OD-B15-S02-T03.line: So the whips came down and the horses flew, through Phera as the sun set, and on to sandy Pylos with the dawn.

OD-B15-S02-T04.line: Son of Nestor, will you do me one kindness more, and drive me past your father's gates, straight down to my ship? Old Nestor's welcome is warm, but it does not let go, and I cannot lose a night to it.

OD-B15-S03-T01.line: Aboard, men, rig the mast and run out the oars. We sail for home now, not at dawn.

OD-B15-S03-T02.line: Friend, by your sacrifice and by the god you pour to, tell me truly who you are, and then hear me. I have killed a kinsman in Argos, and his brothers hunt my life across the islands. Take me aboard, for I am a suppliant and a seer, and I have nowhere on this earth to stand.
OD-B15-S03-T02.direction: breathless, glancing back down the road

OD-B15-S03-T03.line: I will not push away a man who asks. Come aboard; you'll share what we have, and in Ithaca you will be made welcome.
OD-B15-S03-T03.direction: takes his spear, hands him up the plank

OD-B15-S03-T04.line: Grey-eyed Athena sent the wind astern, and the black ship ran through the dark, past Elis and the needle islands, toward Ithaca and the ambush that waited in the strait.

OD-B15-S04-T01.line: At dawn, friend, I'll go down to the town and beg at the great house; perhaps the suitors need a man to carve meat and pour wine. I refuse to eat your bread another day and give nothing back.

OD-B15-S04-T02.line: Tell me of old Laertes, does he still live? And the mother of Odysseus, what became of her? And you yourself, friend: what land bore you, and how did you come to serve this house?

OD-B15-S04-T03.line: I was a king's son once, on the island men call Syria, till a Phoenician woman of my father's house sold me to her traders for trinkets and a passage home. Seven days we ran before the wind; on the seventh she dropped dead in the hold, and they carried me on like cargo, to sell.

OD-B15-S04-T04.line: Come, child. This house is yours now.
OD-B15-S04-T04.direction: memory figure takes the bought boy's hand

OD-B15-S05-T01.line: And as the ship closed on Ithaca, a hawk, Apollo's swift messenger, swept by on the right with a dove torn in its talons, and the feathers fell between Telemachus and the sea.

OD-B15-S05-T02.line: The bird flew on your right hand, Telemachus, no house in Ithaca out-kings yours; the power stays with your line forever!
OD-B15-S05-T02.direction: seizes his arm, eyes on the hawk

OD-B15-S05-T03.line: Crew, take her round to the town harbor without me; I go inland to look over my farms. Tonight I lodge with the herdsmen, and tomorrow evening I'll set out a feast to pay you for the voyage.
OD-B15-S05-T03.direction: calm command, already scanning the hills

OD-B15-S05-T04.line: Piraeus will keep you honorably, friend, until I send for you. Trust him as you would me.
OD-B15-S05-T04.direction: binds his sandals, strikes inland alone
